proposal: IG-01 >= 615.0 MW and IG-02 <= 5,735 kJ/kWh (plant then 602.8 MW / 5,852 kJ/kWh at the IEC limits).
question: The EPC plant HMB (ALP-HMB-SRC-NG-100) gives net 613.1 MW / 5,763 kJ/kWh with 12.25 MW of auxiliary loads and transformer losses. At the IEC guarantee limits IG-01 (614.0 MW gross) and IG-02 (5,745 kJ/kWh gross) the plant would be 601.8 MW / 5,862 kJ/kWh net, i.e. the IEC heat-rate guarantee does not cover the Owner guarantee PG-02 (5,860 kJ/kWh). The consortium cannot carry an uncovered performance LD. Please tighten IG-01/IG-02.
response: IEC accepts IG-01 >= 615.0 MW and IG-02 <= 5,735 kJ/kWh (expected values 625.3 MW / 5,651 kJ/kWh keep 1.7 % and 1.5 % margin). PER-001 Rev A section 7 will show the revised values.
subject: Back-to-back cover of the Owner performance guarantees
